name: com.innov8tif.okayid.cam.OCRActivity
description: OkayID Mobile (Innov8tif identity-document SDK) opens this screen with an identity-document image for card segmentation, feature checks and text recognition. It can also let the user choose or take an image and returns recognized details to the app.
disableEffect: The app cannot extract or receive identity-document details through OkayID Mobile if this screen is disabled.
